title: MV Yanfly Gamepad script call for text boxes? RMMV

posts.author: UncreativeMedia
posts.body:
Hi,
I'm using the Yanfly Gamepad Config plugin, so the players to configure the controlls to their liking.
In the tutorial for my game, the tutorials are shown with the "show text" boxes.
I need a script call that can detect which button is assigned to which action.
(Like Button 1% is assigned to action, Button 2% is assigned to Dash, etc.)
I need this as a script call for a conditional branch, that changes the text depending on which button is assigned.
Is there such a thing, or a way to do this?
Many thanks in advance C:

I think you can do that just fine if "ok" is press as this goes to the keyCode

I don't use gamepad plugin, but I think that is how it is used.
